name: illustrative-stop-and-hold
provenance: Engineering demonstration budgets; not vehicle-approved requirements. Frozen before the recorded campaign, after disclosed development checks.
frame: world ENU metres, seconds, radians; body x-forward y-left z-up
semantics: Reach AND finish the closed-grid dwell window by the deadline; safety invariants apply over the whole observed trace. No trigger with complete telemetry is NOT_EXERCISED.

rover.budget_reason: Illustrative 4.5 m stopping corridor at 1.2 m/s cruise. 2.2 s response plus 0.4 s dwell, below 3.75 s at unchanged cruise; kinematic reference only, contact/actuator feasibility must be tested.

multirotor.budget_reason: Illustrative 6 m safety containment radius at 1.6 m/s cruise, altitude 2 m. 2.5 s response plus 0.5 s dwell; horizontal speed <=0.3 m/s, vertical speed <=0.25 m/s, altitude error <=0.35 m and displacement from actual loss location <=1.5 m all required together. These values require mission-owner approval for any physical vehicle.

campaign.distribution: Independent uniform coordinates over these illustrative ranges; wind magnitude uniform and azimuth uniform on [0,2pi); nav kind and weakened actuator index categorical. IMU constant bias x in +/-0.06 m/s^2 and initial yaw in +/-0.08 rad. No claim about field frequencies. Held-out draws are generated only after freezing source and contract.
